start: Profile > Exercises > Bench Press, logged in 20 workouts over 8 months, last 10 days ago

user_sees: Card 'Previous · <10 days ago>' with last time's set table, warm-ups included
'Best · heaviest weight' (or the kind for this exercise) with its value
must_not: Last time taken from a workout that is not the newest

user_sees: Chips for the chart's measures and the range control '3 months', '12 months', 'All time' opening on 3 months
'Total, last 3 months: <kg> kg in <n> workouts' under a measure that adds up

steps.action: Tap a dot, then its date
Scroll to the records and Set records
user_sees: Each record (tap opens that workout) and the heaviest weight at each rep count up to 12
must_not: Warm-up or 0 kg sets in the Set records table

start: Pull Up always logged at +0 kg (or imported from Hevy as weight and reps at 0 kg)

user_sees: Previous and Best read as reps ('Best · most reps')

Best is the longest or farthest

user_sees: 'No sets logged yet' with 'Add this exercise to a workout and your progress will land here.'
